The '''Iskin system''' was located within the [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] shared its name with the [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Star of Iskin]]''.<ref name="R61">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Iskin system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-16.<ref name="TEA" />
